reason: No. My team runs different agents and I can't force them onto one; I already pay for Cursor/Copilot and I'm reluctant to add another tool. The shared-layer pitch fits my situation, but loyalty to what we already use wins and I won't pay $30 a seat for something my team won't adopt.
objection: My team uses different agents; I can't force them all onto one, and I already pay for Cursor/Copilot.
would_change_my_mind: If my team actually standardized on a single agent so the shared layer had something to share.
